title: Relational AI: A Plural Governance Framework for AI Agents
description: The Hugging Face breach exposes a risk-management challenge that AI agents make increasingly urgent: how can open systems support broad communication and cooperation without allowing low-context interactions to cascade into high-consequence access—or making surveillance the price of coordination? This talk introduces communication currencies—a relational architecture modeled on human communication—whose useful frictions preserve the differences on which cooperation depends, even as it scales.
